about: Alkalimetalle: Lithium, Natrium und Kalium reagieren mit Wasser zu Lauge und Wasserstoff

Li(s).src: CODATA Key Values for Thermodynamics (Cox, Wagman, Medvedev 1989): S = 29.12 J/(mol K)

Na(s).src: CODATA Key Values for Thermodynamics (Cox, Wagman, Medvedev 1989): S = 51.30 J/(mol K)

K(s).src: CODATA Key Values for Thermodynamics (Cox, Wagman, Medvedev 1989): S = 64.68 J/(mol K)

reactions.src: estimated: a piece of lithium (0.03 g) reacts with water in about a minute, calmly with steady bubbling
estimated: a pea-sized piece of sodium (0.1 g) is used up on water in about ten seconds
estimated: a lentil-sized piece of potassium (0.05 g) is used up on water in a few seconds
